scope: Retrospective chronological research on already consumed six-month survivor prices. No broker/depth/stops/lot minima or intrahorizon path; not actual mock policy or deployability proof.
limitations: One fixed8h/12h target, no horizon/parameter/test-result search.
Train transforms/weights only on strictly matured labels; validation selects zero/mean/ridge by fixed MAE/coverage rule.
Same full test rows including abstentions as zero, nonoverlapping test windows; correlated markets/rolling training remain dependent.
Paired cost stress keeps selected symbols/clocks and fractional allocation rule, not identical absolute quantities after prior cash changes. Adaptive stress changes selection.
Continuous source data use bounded750history; initial warmup and later-informed universe constrain historical interpretation.
Fixed-horizon diagnostic is not source breakout/hourly policyPnL, protective stops or a deployable strategy.
